fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami policing and civil-rights implications of arrests and lawsuits; debate over proposed Florida sales-tax measures and a Governor Warren special session tax committee hearing in Miami; discussion of polio precautions for school reopening; criticism of a proposed Miami world’s fair on the city Graves tract; local concerns including low-flying training planes over residential areas, municipal water-rate billing practices, zoning and building activity (including Coral Gables), and Miami Beach public-beach acquisition proposals. Also contains local court and crime notes, traffic-safety commentary, and tourism-related promotion and statistics.
